_note: OpenRouter is an aggregator that proxies models from many authors under namespaced slugs (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5', 'openai/gpt-4o'). Pricing varies by upstream and changes often; OpenRouter also returns usage/cost in its API response. Intentionally left unseeded — add specific slugs here only if a model is used heavily enough to warrant a pinned local rate. Use the pricepertoken MCP get_model(provider='openrouter') for on-demand lookups.
